entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand GPS Tracker. Just give me the return number, I don't have a lot of time.
I can certainly help you with that. To pull up your order, could I get your full name and order number, please?

Mark Chen, order number is VF908876. Listen, just a yes or no. I had a family medical emergency and was at the hospital for weeks after a relative needed surgery. The box is unopened. Can I return it?
I'm very sorry to hear about the emergency, Mr. Chen. Let me check the policy for you right now. One moment while I pull up the details.
Okay, I see the order was delivered 39 days ago. According to our policy, you have 90 days to make a return. So yes, you are well within the window. We can absolutely get this processed for you.
Good. That's all I needed. What's next?

I've just initiated the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on your account. And since you're a VIP member with us, I've gone ahead and authorized the full refund immediately. You won't have to wait for the warehouse to receive the item. The funds should appear in your account within 3 to 5 business days.
Okay, that works. I appreciate the quick service. Thank you, Diana.
You're very welcome, Mr. Chen. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a better rest of your day.
